description: Defines a template class 'concurrent_queue' specialized for lockfree MPMC queues with non-blocking and sleep-based wait policies, including methods for push, pop, bulk operations, and consumer creation.

classes.name: concurrent_queue<T, concurrent_queue_policy::lockfree_mpmc, concurrent_queue_wait_policy::non_blocking>
classes.description: A lockfree multi-producer multi-consumer queue with non-blocking operations.

classes.name: concurrent_queue<T, concurrent_queue_policy::lockfree_mpmc, concurrent_queue_wait_policy::sleep>
classes.description: A lockfree MPMC queue with sleep-based blocking wait policy, extending the non-blocking version.

methods.name: try_push
methods.description: Attempts to push an element into the queue without blocking.

methods.name: try_push_bulk
methods.description: Attempts to push a bulk of elements into the queue.

methods.name: push_blocking
methods.description: Pushes an element into the queue, blocking if necessary.

methods.name: try_pop
methods.description: Attempts to pop an element from the queue without blocking.

methods.name: try_pop_bulk
methods.description: Attempts to pop multiple elements from the queue.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the current size of the queue.

methods.name: empty
methods.description: Checks if the queue is empty.

methods.name: capacity
methods.description: Returns the maximum capacity of the queue.

methods.name: create_consumer
methods.description: Creates a consumer object for the queue.
